specs.title: TC-01: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: 1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. The account menu shows Login and no email
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. The account menu shows the email and Logout

specs.title: TC-02: Add a product to the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Add the product to the basket
3. Open the basket
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: TC-03: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Click plus in the row of product A
3. Click minus in the row of product A
4. Click minus in the row of product A again
5. Click trash in the row of product A

specs.title: TC-04: Purchase limit for one product

steps.title: 1. Add the product from the product list
2. Click plus until the quantity is 5
3. Click plus one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Add the product again from the product list

specs.title: TC-05: Valid coupon on the payment step

steps.title: 1. Open the basket and click Checkout
2. Select the saved address and continue
3. Select One Day Delivery and continue
4. Redeem the coupon of the current month
5. Select the saved card and continue

specs.title: TC-06: Invalid coupon and expired coupon

steps.title: 1. Checkout with the saved address
2. Select One Day Delivery and continue
3. Redeem the invalid code
4. Redeem the expired coupon
5. Select the saved card and continue
